```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: iris-plot
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Measurements for Different Species of Iris",
    subtitle = "Virginica has the longest sepals",
    x = "Sepal Width",
    y = "Sepal Length",
    caption = "Fisher (1936)"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      setosa = "#F8766D",
      versicolor = "#00BA38",
      virginica = "#619CFF"
    )
  )
```
